attributes.description: What panel should hold the icons for the minimap. Must be a sibling of this map. Useful if you want to have a z-index difference between terrain/icons

attributes.name: stickyfadeoutalpha
attributes.description: What transparency the icon will display at when far from the sticky radius

attributes.name: stickyfadeoutdistance
attributes.description: This distance away from the sticky radius, the icon will be using stickyfadeoutalpha. Expressed as a distance past the sticky radius.

attributes.description: Important minimap icons will always display at this radius when further away from the center from the radius

attributes.name: dragclickzone
attributes.description: If >= 0, drags longer than this distance will suppress mouse click events (e.g. onactivate of embedded panels)

attributes.name: invertminscalecalc
attributes.description: If this is > 0, the min scale is set to account for the higher value, where the smaller dimension is maxed out first

attributes.name: minscale
attributes.description: Just ignore the calculations, you can zoom to this amount (will validate that this is <= maxscale)

attributes.name: multitouchzoomscale
attributes.description: Scale for the pinch zoom gesture.

attributes.name: strictclamptranslation
attributes.description: If this is > 0, don't let the content panel translate in a way that would let you see through the frame
